title: Skill Completion Event
description: Schema for skill completion event files written to .moeb/events/ by fix_signal and run skills.
filename_convention: {yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ}_{id}.event.json where id is signal_id for fix_signal events or run_id for run events

event_type.description: Discriminates fix_signal events (signal_fixed, signal_fix_failed) from run events (run_completed, run_failed).

signal_id.description: For fix_signal events: UUID of the resolved signal (required). For run events: signal that triggered the run, or null.

fix_branch.description: fix_signal events only: branch created for the fix; null if branch not yet created at failure time.

run_id.description: run events only: UUID of the run.

candidate_tag.description: run events only: candidate tag created by this run; null if QA gate failed or tag not created.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the event was written.

reason.description: Failure events only (signal_fix_failed, run_failed): brief description of the failure.
